If anyone has suggestions on permissions settings or on migration, let me know.

Once the migration is done it would be helpful to git newbies (such as myself) if someone could post a rough set of instructions on how to make our current repositories point to the new one.  In particular, I have some local branches that I'd rather not loose or have to manually port over.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Move from Google Code to Github
parts:
Will you have access to the machine with the local
branches when you're here? If so, we can help you
push those branches back to the origin (now Google code)
before we migrate.

Otherwise, git makes it pretty easy to calculate a patch
and then apply it.

I don't know if there's a way to have the current repository
point to the new one.

- Bob
